properties.description: DesignGraph::loop_closure (crates/reflow2-core/src/loop_closure.rs) reads each live Verification's reconcile stamp and every status_mismatch DriftEvent, and classifies the design as nothing_to_close / never_closed / closed_without_a_failure / a_failure_came_back, with counts, the last dated comparison and one plain sentence. LoopStatus.loop_closure carries it; an unscoped loop_status adds a `next` line for never_closed AFTER `clean` is computed. The where-am-i skill reads it beside the delivery line. A check merely TYPED as failing is a claim and does not count as a failure that came back.
properties.name: loop_status carries the loop-closure reading — whether a real result ever came back — and says never_closed in next without counting it against clean
